heroDesc: Explore the world of chemistry through vibrant 3D graphics. From atoms to reactions — all before your eyes.
featurePeriodicDesc: 118 elements with interactive effects. Filter by group, period, physical state.
featureExplorerDesc: Interactive 3D Sandbox: Render modes, explode view, specs & atomic coordinates.
featureLabDesc: 3D virtual chemical reaction simulator. Combine chemicals and observe results.
featureLessonsDesc: Learn chemical bond theory & practice interactive multiple choice quizzes.
